- Remove retired models from CLI model lists and model picker results

1.0.108.text:
- Add `sandbox.userPolicy.filesystem.enumeratePaths` in `settings.json` for Windows enumerate-only directory grants
- Add /index commands and enable managed shared tgrep indexing by default for eligible repositories
- PDF attachments on Grok 4.7 and Grok 4.6 fall back to file references instead of failing the turn
- With the sandbox on, a running local MCP server is now restarted after `/cd`, so it follows the new directory's denied paths instead of keeping those of the directory the session left.
- A file attachment sent through the SDK that points at a named pipe, socket or device is now tagged as an error instead of stalling the turn until something writes to the pipe.
- The canvas tools now tell the model which instance IDs `open_canvas` accepts, instead of calling them free-form.
- /model now lists models when Copilot answers the model list request with 421 Misdirected Request, for example after a plan change, by re-resolving your account's endpoint as chat turns already do instead of showing "Error loading model list".
- Requests to OpenAI-compatible chat-completions providers no longer include an internal message field on skill and tool messages.
- Ctrl+C now stops a running /compact, as Esc Esc does, instead of only arming the exit hint and quitting the CLI on a second press.
- The /config help no longer shows literal backticks or uses a model outside the model list as its example.
- Your defaultMode setting now applies when you close the startup session picker while the session is still loading its model, instead of the session staying in its previous mode.
- A disabledSkills entry, skills.disable and skills.enable now match a skill name in any letter case, as invoking the skill does, instead of silently doing nothing when the case differs.
- Creating or resuming an SDK session, or replacing its tools, with two custom tools of the same name is now an error. Before, the model was offered the first definition while some SDKs ran the handler of the last one.
- Copilot no longer crashes with an unhandled exception at startup when it cannot save its first-launch timestamp, for example because the disk holding the Copilot home directory is full. The failure is logged and startup continues.
- The Getting started box no longer suggests /init in a folder where you ran /init suppress, in a repository that already has Copilot instructions, or outside a git repository.
- `copilot help config` now names the `.claude/rules` instruction files and the `.claude/settings.json` repository settings the CLI reads.
- copilot help input now says that esc esc also stops a running /compact, and that in shell mode a single esc or ctrl+c on an empty prompt leaves shell mode
- `/help` now describes `ctrl+d` (exits only on an empty prompt, otherwise deletes the next character) and `ctrl+z` on Windows correctly, and lists `ctrl+j`, `ctrl+v`, `ctrl+y` and the voice input keys.
- copilot help limits now quotes the rate-limit prompt as local sessions show it, "Switch to Copilot Fusion mode?", instead of "Switch to auto mode?".
- copilot help mcp now says that a directory's .github/mcp.json is ignored when the same directory has a .mcp.json, instead of implying the two files are merged
- copilot help monitoring now describes the github.copilot.sandbox.operation.count metric as counting every sandbox decision by kind, not only deduplicated posture changes.
- Pasting an image path again after clearing its `[image: ...]` label with Ctrl+U, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+W or an Up-arrow history recall attaches the image again instead of inserting the plain path.
- Backspace, an arrow key, Ctrl+U or Shift+Enter pressed right after a paste now acts after the pasted text instead of on the text in front of it.
- Picking an MCP server type by its number in the add or edit form now moves focus to the next field for that type.
- /permissions default in Autopilot now asks again how to handle permissions on the next prompt, as /permissions manual does, instead of leaving Autopilot to deny every tool request.
- A queued `/ask` or `/btw` that runs while another side answer is open now shows that it is still thinking, instead of showing the previous answer as its own finished answer for Ctrl+Y to copy.
- copilot --resume <name> and /resume <name> now find a session whose name has an accent typed precomposed or decomposed, whichever spelling the session was saved with.
- In /search, Up, Down and Enter bring a single match back into view after you scroll away, and a shorter terminal no longer leaves the current match off screen.
- /security-review help now says it reviews the branch diff when the working tree is clean, not only staged and unstaged changes
- Escape sequences in checkpoint titles, file names, Copilot home paths and generated agent names no longer restyle /session info or the /agent wizard.
- Long values in `/session info`, such as the log and session file paths, now wrap under their own column instead of back under the label
- Switching to another session no longer occasionally replaces that session's model with Auto while the model list reloads.
- `/share` usage no longer implies that `/share` alone exports a markdown file; it shows that a bare path must contain `/`, `.` or `~`.
- A path or URL route in a prompt, such as /docs/setup.md, no longer loads a skill named after its first segment (docs) as if you had invoked that skill.
- Subcommands of `/pr`, `/lsp`, `/skills`, `/plugin`, `/user` and `/collect-debug-logs` now match in any letter case, so `/lsp TEST my-server` runs the test instead of showing usage text.
- Help for `/experimental` and `/theme` now marks `/experimental on|off` and `/theme <mode>` as deprecated and points at `/settings`, and `/mcp disable` is no longer described as temporary: it is saved across sessions.
- A repository `sessionStart` prompt hook that runs `/clear <prompt>` or `/new` now starts one new session instead of starting another one in every session it creates.
- The duration shown on a sub-agent no longer counts the time its tool calls spent at permission prompts.
- The `/subagents` help no longer promises a default subagent model. It now says the command configures each subagent's model and settings and turns subagents on or off.
- Tab characters in replies, error messages, agent names and other text are now shown as spaces instead of being dropped, so tab-separated words no longer run together.
- The duration shown on a tool call no longer counts the time spent at its permission prompt, and it does not tick while the prompt is open.
- The `/update` channel choices now say that picking `stable` or `prerelease` also saves it as your update channel for future updates.
- Preserve input queued behind a paste when resizing the terminal
- Memory import reports malformed repository scopes without a false unsupported host error
- Show a warning when a selected custom agent's configured skills are missing or cannot be loaded
- Include session start, resume, and model-change events in `-p --output-format json` output
- Keep built-in agents selected with --agent active when opening /agent or refreshing available agents
- Interactive CLI sessions pass local MCP server environment values literally; use ${NAME} to reference a host environment variable
- Allow semantic code search to find renamed repositories when the checkout still uses the old name
- Use Ctrl+T to show and hide First Pass reasoning when Fusion is selected through a routing profile
- Keep the selected match in view when opening /search or /find instead of jumping to the bottom of the conversation.
- Allow the system to sleep again after a background MCP reload finishes when using /keep-alive busy.
- Keep the footer's plan hint visible when a nonempty plan is available
- Interactive Autopilot waits for your response to MCP input and consent requests instead of automatically declining them
- /mcp enable now respects repository settings that disable an MCP server
- Renaming files with the patch tool now succeeds without requiring changes to their contents
- File diffs in the concise transcript show terminal escape sequences as visible characters and preserve added and removed line colors
- Reduce CPU usage during builds in large worktrees when language servers watch for file changes
- Headless runs now report an error when resuming a session in use by another Copilot process, keeping its history intact.
- MCP deny rules now block a tool named the way its MCP server advertises it (for example `server(weather.lookup)`), not only its sanitized name, even with --allow-all-tools
- On Linux, language servers are no longer told that the files in a directory were deleted when the directory is renamed away and straight back.
- On Linux, language servers are now told when a directory is renamed (the old files deleted, the new ones created) while other directories in the workspace are being created and removed, such as during a package install.
- A canvas that was open when a session was resumed is now restored even if its extension restarts while the canvas is being reopened, instead of staying unavailable.
- When a preToolUse hook asks about several parallel tool calls, each call gets its own confirmation again: answering No with feedback to one no longer denies the others without asking.
- Attaching an empty PDF or Office document no longer fails the turn on models that read documents natively; the empty file is passed as a file reference instead.
- Connect to an already running /voice server even when its PID file is missing
- /limits unset now clears session AI credit caps for subsequent requests
- `/plugin install` from a repository, URL or local path now shows the same deprecation warning that `copilot plugin install` prints.
- Automatic updates are no longer skipped for a launch when signing in takes more than about a second
- /changelog <version> can retrieve release notes for versions not bundled with the CLI
- A turn that ends while the session event log cannot be written now still ends with `session.idle`, so `sendAndWait` no longer times out on a turn that completed.
- The grep and glob tools now return the matches they found when a file or directory under the search path cannot be read, with a note naming what was skipped, instead of failing with only the permission error.
- Apply reasoning effort changes made during a tool call to the next model request on supported models, without waiting for another prompt
- Since 1.0.104, Assisted Permissions judge calls are sent as agent requests and no longer count as separate premium requests
- Answer questions about Copilot CLI behavior from this build's own documentation and clearly say when docs do not cover a question.
- Keep successful command output and file diffs collapsed in concise transcript mode until expanded, while keeping running output and failure details visible.
- Show MCP form validation errors beside inputs, focus the first invalid field, and improve screen-reader labels and cursor positioning
- Since 1.0.106, Autopilot with Assisted Permissions no longer stops for permission prompts; the agent tries another approach and reports the actions it could not take
- Managed plugin assignments with state "defaultEnabled" now install and activate plugins by default while preserving user overrides.

1.0.109.text:

- Add support for Claude Fable 5.2 in the model picker under New models

- Removing a built-in MCP server with `copilot mcp remove` or `/mcp delete` explains how to disable it instead
- Selecting a directory next to your home directory in `/cd ~` or `/add-dir ~` uses the correct full path
- Trusted-folder and worktree confirmations keep Windows path separators
- Hide empty assistant reply bullets when a response contains only whitespace
- Choosing "don't ask again" for parallel file operations approves all covered requests without prompting again
- Make /terminal-setup configure Shift+Enter in the correct location for VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf on Linux when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is set
- The footer's AI credits now update as soon as `/compact` finishes instead of after the next turn
- Prompt mode with --output-format json emits a final result record with an exit status even when a run fails early
- Rate-limit errors now name the same mode as the switch dialog (Copilot Fusion mode or auto mode) instead of "auto model"
- In a multi-line prompt, Up and Down now start from the cursor after Left, Right, Backspace, Delete or a similar key that had nothing to act on at the start or end of the text, instead of jumping to the column of the previous Up/Down run
- Number keys keep working in shell and URL approval dialogs after pressing the number of the "No, and tell Copilot" option and moving back up
- `/cd .` and `/add-dir .` now keep the current directory in a git repository instead of selecting `.git`; the directory picker lists `./` first and still offers hidden directories below it
- In ACP mode, a preToolUse hook that answers ask now asks the ACP client to allow or deny the tool call instead of denying it as host policy
- /voice immediately reports an overly long socket path and how to fix it, instead of waiting before showing a generic error.
- File move permission prompts show both source and destination paths, and pure renames no longer show an empty diff.
- Session history keeps every turn when a second window works on a session another window still has open
- The `beepOnSchedule` setting description now says it controls the beep when a scheduled `/every` or `/after` turn finishes, and only while `beep` is on, instead of a beep when the prompt fires
- The `companyAnnouncements` setting description now says one message, picked at random, appears in the timeline as a Company announcement notice, not in the startup banner
- `copilot help config` no longer says turning off `compactPaste` shows every paste in full; pastes over 20 KB are still saved to a workspace file
- `copilot help config` now names the home screen tabs as they appear, Current and Sessions, instead of Session and Agents
- The `ctrl+h` entry in the keyboard shortcut help now says it deletes the previous word in local Windows terminals, where the terminal sends the same key for `ctrl+h` and `ctrl+backspace`
- The `footer.showModelEffort` setting description now says it toggles only the reasoning effort label next to the model name, which always shows, and that the effort shows briefly after it changes when the setting is unset
- `copilot help config` no longer names staff-only and internal settings, such as `taskbarPresence`, `showTipsOnStartup` and `streamerMode`
- The `ide.openDiffOnEdit` setting description now says the IDE diff opens for a file edit waiting for your approval, and that accepting or rejecting it answers that prompt, instead of a diff on every edit
- Text typed after /init now reaches the model as extra guidance for the generated instructions file and appears in the timeline, instead of being silently dropped.

- IDE auto-connect follows your current folder after /cd, keeping editor selections and diffs in the correct IDE
- Expanded Shell output preserves text before and after diffs and shows file names for diff-only output
- Keep `copilot lsp list` output free of warnings when plugin language servers load successfully
- Deleting the active voice model now shows that voice mode is off and how to choose another model.
- Show the output size instead of an incorrect match count when search results are too large to list
- MCP server and skill enable/disable commands correctly report success for names supplied through --additional-mcp-config or --plugin-dir
- Keep dialog borders and padding aligned when a line ends with an invisible zero-width character
- List items in plan and task summaries stay on one line when they contain literal asterisks or sentences ending in numbers
- Show the enabled state enforced by your organization's managed settings for built-in plugins in `copilot plugin list` and `--json` output
- Apply changes to Disable bypass permissions mode in /settings immediately, without restarting the CLI
- /cd, /cwd, and /add-dir select the exact directory name you type when siblings differ only by case or accents
- Hide custom agents with built-in names from /subagents so their controls cannot change built-in agent settings
- Preserve first-line indentation in shell command output so expanded Shell rows correctly show spacing-sensitive results such as git status --short
- Shell commands terminated by a signal report the correct exit status, such as 137 for SIGKILL or 139 for a segmentation fault
- Show a confirmation when a model switch queued while the agent is working takes effect
- Show the output size instead of an incorrect line count in Shell summaries when command output is too large to display
- Footer context usage shows the same pre-request percentage as /context.
- Plan quota and Copilot usage stay visible in the status line, /usage and the exit summary while a GitHub-hosted model is selected, even when providers.json configures a custom provider; they are hidden only while a model from that provider is selected
- Prompt history is no longer hidden, and then erased by the next prompt, when the file that stores session mentions for past prompts is damaged or was written by a newer version
- The ctrl+y footer hint no longer misses a plan written right after the session starts, and it keeps updating when the plan file cannot be watched
- Hook events and other JSON settings can be saved from their editor in /settings; unset hook events now open as an empty list
- Resuming a session by name with --resume no longer sends the session name in telemetry; only a session ID is reported
- Exiting no longer writes dozens of errors to the process log about cleaning up a session that has already shut down
- /sandbox no longer replaces your saved sandbox settings with defaults when settings.json has an invalid value; it shows the load error instead, and a sandbox path saved from a permission prompt is refused rather than overwriting the sandbox block
- A prompt submitted while Compact and switch is compacting shows as queued again, instead of disappearing until the compaction finishes
- Disabling an MCP server updates its token count in /mcp without waiting for another model response
- On Linux, language servers that watch files are no longer told that files still on disk were deleted after two files or directories are swapped through a temporary name
- copilot -p in a trusted folder no longer sometimes runs without the repository's hooks when plugins finish loading at the same time
- `copilot mcp remove` and `/mcp remove` now delete an `mcp-config.json` entry that is skipped as invalid instead of reporting that the server was not found
- Resuming a session by ID or name with `/resume` now keeps the session you leave open in the background, so it still runs its sessionEnd hooks, records its shutdown and is listed when you exit
- `copilot -p` and other CLI runs that exit within a minute now apply process-log retention, so old logs are removed after 7 days and beyond the newest 50 instead of piling up one per run
- `copilot plugin marketplace add ./name`, `../name` and `~/name` now add the local marketplace directory instead of trying to clone a GitHub repository
- A shell command killed because the sandbox settings changed while it ran is now reported as failed instead of as a successful command with no output
- The warning for an unsupported --reasoning-effort value is no longer lost when the session's model changes while the CLI is starting
- `copilot help ''` prints the general help and exits successfully, just like `copilot help`.
- A `/compact` with nothing to compact no longer leaves a stale "Compacting conversation history..." row in the timeline
- An mcp-config.json that cannot be read or is not a JSON object now fails with an error that names the file and the actual problem, and a syntax error in a file with comments or trailing commas points at the real mistake instead of the first comment or comma
- Selecting an unavailable account in /user switch shows recovery guidance and a retry action
- Click anywhere in expanded reasoning to collapse it without scrolling back to the header
- Offer a session AI-credit limit top-up at 90% usage, before the agent loses access to tools
- Remove legacy remote steering; cloud sessions and remote connections now require an AHP environment

1.0.111.text:
- Add regular expression support to enterprise-managed Shell, Bash, and PowerShell permission rules
- Add --host-allow-session-creation to let remote clients create sessions on CLI hosts for one launch without changing saved settings
- Refresh /usage premium request usage so percentages stay current.
- Prevent duplicate MCP OAuth reconnects and keep servers in needs-auth after canceled authorization
- Markdown tables containing a wide symbol followed by the text variation selector, such as ⌛︎, render with correctly aligned rows
- The `footer.showCodeChanges` setting description now says it shows the lines added and removed by Copilot's file edits in this session, not pending changes
- The `/usage` activity graph now fits narrow terminals by showing fewer weeks, instead of wrapping every day row in two
- Shell output and custom status lines display correctly when terminal control sequences appear, without applying unintended text styles
- /rewind with Conversation + files no longer counts, lists or reports as restored a file that later turns had already put back or deleted again
- Interactive /plugin marketplace commands find repository-local marketplaces when the CLI starts in a subdirectory
- Keep selection labels readable and rows aligned in /environments when using --screen-reader
- /skills get without a skill name and the /mcp usage text name the get and remove verbs instead of the retired info and delete
- /diff shows a clear notice for binary files instead of garbled text or an empty pane
- The `/usage` activity graph hides its legend in narrow panes to prevent it from wrapping onto extra lines
- The $ shell shortcut reports launch failures once with a clear reason, including when Ctrl+G opens the editor at the same time.
- /mcp search installs registry servers with URL variables using the values you enter
- Custom status lines render terminal colors and formatting correctly, without stray characters after color resets.
- Hook approval dialogs show control characters in tool names and arguments as visible text instead of hiding or restyling them
- /session delete-all, /session prune, and /session delete preserve sessions running in the background in the same window
- Text that fits on one row stays on one row after resizing the terminal
- In `/workflows`, a run's Agents list no longer runs off the bottom of a short terminal: the selected agent stays on screen, and a long phase title stays on one row
- copilot plugin enable, disable, update and uninstall now fail and name config.json when it cannot be parsed, instead of reporting success without a change or that the plugin is not installed
- `--no-color` preserves text styling while disabling colors, even when `FORCE_COLOR` is set
- Pasted image paths attach correctly when you press Enter immediately after pasting in terminals that mark pasted input
- Keep the selected /share action visible when navigation keys cannot move the selection in short terminals
- MCP forms show validation errors immediately for answers edited in an external editor with Ctrl+G
- Running `copilot --continue` with no previous session shows the welcome header and Getting started box.
- Keep the Sessions tab responsive when dialogs open during navigation, and show pending dialogs where they can be answered
- Keep the highlighted confirmation option visible in the Sessions tab and /environments on short terminals
- Keep the /theme picker's title and border on screen in narrow terminals and beside the docked Sessions sidebar, dropping the preview instead
- The /share screen keeps the selected action visible in narrow terminals
- /ask and /btw show answers correctly beside the Sessions sidebar in narrow terminals
- Keep the /tasks title and borders visible when the task list is longer than the terminal can display
- `copilot -p "/compact" --silent` no longer prints the compaction result line to stdout, so `--silent` output stays limited to the agent's response
- Keep the prompt, tab bar, and status line visible when typing a multi-line draft during the startup animation on short terminals
- /diff shows staged renames under their new names, including edits made while renaming
- With experimental dynamic workflows, a workflow's own agent can no longer start or resume workflow runs, so a workflow can no longer start copies of itself without limit when all tools are allowed.
- With the high-contrast theme on a 16 or 256-colour terminal, the Sessions tab shows the status icon of the selected row instead of drawing it blue on blue
- Follow-ups typed while the agent is working now run in the order they were typed; one that reached the session between two turns is no longer overtaken by follow-ups typed after it.
- The /usage activity graph counts only the prompts you typed, not sub-agent or autopilot prompts, and its message total matches the days the graph draws
- Pasted escape sequences no longer change text colours or hide text in search fields
- copilot -p with --trust-folder, run from a subdirectory of a repository, now warns that the hooks at the repository root were not loaded and says how to load them
- Custom status lines display non-ASCII characters correctly even when commands write them in pieces
- Copying inline code from wrapped rows after resizing the terminal no longer includes extra non-breaking spaces.
- Queued slash commands now show an error when they fail instead of disappearing silently
- Prompts sent as a turn finishes now run without waiting for background agents to complete
- Dragging the sessions divider or scrollbar now ends cleanly when the left mouse button is no longer held.
- Allow your own scratch files under /tmp on macOS without path permission prompts unless --disallow-temp-dir is set
- Re-attaching an image or document after switching models or compacting a session sends its content to the model
- Show an error when /update cannot download a release instead of leaving the download progress message indefinitely
- Sessions started with /new or from the Sessions tab can be controlled from GitHub when remote sessions are enabled
- Expand ${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT} in plugin hook working directories and environment values
- Push-to-talk preserves dictated text when held Space key repeats pause and resume
- OAuth sign-in for remote MCP servers works through proxies that require Kerberos (Negotiate) authentication
- Show permission prompts, questions, and confirmations directly in the sub-agent view so you can respond without leaving it
- Keep text after terminal control sequences visible in labels and output, and hide embedded image data
- Search in /skills, /mcp, and /plugin matches visible text instead of words hidden inside terminal escape sequences
- Clear the previous profile's routed model from the footer and custom status line when switching Copilot Fusion profiles
- Prevent @ file mentions and /sandbox path completion from selecting outdated suggestions when typing quickly
- The /sandbox Credentials tab counts masked environment variables separately from unmasked suggestions
- /resume keeps session rows aligned and columns visible with --screen-reader, and announces unread status once
- Show all rows of wrapped Japanese, Chinese, and Korean text without clipping the last row or leaving extra blank rows
- Resizing the terminal during a text-selection drag preserves the clipboard instead of copying empty lines or unhighlighted text
- Keep the @ file picker up to date when ignore files change above the working directory
- Autopilot confirmation hides Assisted Permissions when disabled by administrator policy and explains why they are unavailable.
- Keep /config view tabs and the selected view readable in screen-reader mode on narrow terminals
- Exiting the CLI on macOS and Linux now stops attached background shells even when they ignore termination signals.
- Sandboxed MCP startup errors identify refused filesystem operations even when the server prints a stack trace
- /mcp token counts exclude tools deferred by client-side tool search
- Preserve freshly pasted text when stashing or opening the external editor, and prevent Ctrl+D from exiting while a paste is pending
- Prevent the # issue and pull request picker from selecting outdated results when typing quickly
- /plugin Details shows repository-local plugins without a User scope label and keeps versions separate from descriptions
- Workspace MCP servers resolve relative working directories from their config's directory level, including after /cd or when launching from a subdirectory
- /mcp delete removes a server without restarting other connected MCP servers
- Keep Sessions sidebar and shell shortcut hints readable in narrow terminals by hiding hints that do not fit
- Queued Copilot Fusion routing-profile changes show an acknowledgement when the current turn ends, before the next prompt.
- Keep /diff responsive with large untracked files and show untracked symlinks by their target paths instead of their contents
- HTML exports and rich-text copies preserve generic types and placeholders written in angle brackets, such as Vec<String> and <file>
- Allow image generation when settings.json is empty or contains only whitespace
- Keep the current location highlighted and announced to screen readers in narrow /config views while the area list has focus.
- Installing MCP servers from the registry with optional fields left blank now preserves server defaults instead of saving placeholder text
- Show agent IDs in /subagents when custom agents share a name, so you can tell which agent you configure
- Keep /ask and /btw question headers in plain text when pasting colored terminal output or control characters
- Keep the terminal's own colors in editors opened with Ctrl+G and shells opened with $ when the CLI's theme changes
- MCP registry installs preserve npm launch arguments when the server already includes an install confirmation flag
- Keep text typed immediately after a paste separate, so pasted image paths attach correctly and text after long pastes remains editable
- Keep /config view tabs intact and the selected area visible on narrow terminals
- Editor shortcuts stay inactive while the CLI exits, keeping the terminal ready for the shell
- Show MCP servers that return an empty authentication challenge in the /mcp auth picker
- Pasting text into Ctrl+R history search ignores escape sequences so matches, colors, and cursor placement stay correct
- Pasting colored text into /plugin, /skills, and /mcp search matches the visible text and preserves dashboard colors
- Emoji stay readable under the cursor in /model search, and long /diff search queries scroll on one line
- Long search queries in the Sessions tab and /resume wrap correctly and keep the cursor aligned with typed text.
- /diff lists copied files correctly when Git copy detection is enabled and preserves files whose names end in spaces
- Keep Copilot model access when account lookups are rate-limited
- Keep the exit status of a collapsed failed shell row whole in narrow terminals, and show as much of the command description as fits beside it
- Deleting a session through the SDK while one of its client tools is running now cancels that tool's handler, instead of leaving it running after the session is gone.
- A GITHUB_ASKPASS helper that never answers no longer stalls startup for over five minutes; sign-in now fails after one helper timeout
- After `/code` hands a session off to VS Code, resuming that session in the same window and switching back no longer brings back the notice that it is open in VS Code Chat
- Keep Windows drive letters with their paths when wrapping command previews in approval dialogs
- A config.json that cannot be read, such as one with an extra closing brace or one cut short by an interrupted write, is no longer replaced at startup by a file holding only firstLaunchAt; its trusted folders, plugins, marketplaces and other saved state stay in the file
- MCP enable/disable and plugin commands work when settings.json is empty
- A remote MCP server that refuses or closes the first connection at session start, for example while it is still starting, is retried as planned instead of staying failed for the rest of the session
- With sidebar.hoverFocus off and sidebar.showCloseButton on, moving the mouse over a Sessions sidebar card no longer moves the selection onto it
- Copying an answer with the mouse keeps the blank lines inside blockquotes
- The "Compacting conversation history" counter keeps counting from when the compaction started after the queue manager is opened and closed, instead of restarting at 0
- A plugin whose plugin.json location holds a named pipe or a link to a device such as /dev/zero no longer hangs or exhausts memory when skills, prompts or plugin lists load it; the file is skipped like an unreadable manifest
- Shell tool results no longer keep terminal escape sequences or hyperlink targets when a sequence is split across two reads of the command's output, as happens with coloured output larger than one read
- After /compact, the runtime no longer keeps a CPU core busy until the next event, and the session's live event stream no longer skips events that arrive after a compaction removed earlier ones
- A permission_prompt notification hook no longer runs for a request that Assisted Permissions approves without asking
- Adding or changing a repository's GitHub remote while the CLI is running is now picked up straight away, so `/pr` no longer keeps saying the repository is not connected to GitHub until the CLI restarts.
- When an extension fails to load, its log now shows the full error report, including the file and line of a syntax error, the stack trace and any cause, instead of a single line.
- The Sessions sidebar row of the session you are in shows it working for the whole of a running turn, and screen readers hear "status working" instead of "status done"
- With Auto selected, the footer's context percentage and the status line's displayed_context_limit now use the window of the model Auto routed to, matching /context, instead of a fixed 200,000 tokens
- The standalone CLI now re-extracts its cached package when cli-native.node has gone missing from it, instead of failing on every start with Native addon "cli-native" not found
- A workflow run that a session filesystem SQLite provider committed but reported as postCommitAmbiguous now starts, instead of failing and leaving a pending run that cannot be cancelled or resumed
- An extension prompt asking for many sensitive environment variables on a short terminal now keeps the first listed name and the count of the rest on screen instead of scrolling every name out of view
- The CLI's selection copies inline code and color swatches without decorative padding when their background color is shown
- Context from multiple userPromptSubmitted hooks now reaches the model instead of only the last hook's context
- Show organization support links in policy guidance and managed settings notices
- Indexed search becomes available sooner after restarting, and its enabled notice appears only when the index can serve searches.

1.0.112.text:
- A failed /compact now shows the model provider's error message without an internal host-rethrow prefix
- A prompt the CLI does not send yet, such as one entered while managed account policy is still loading, keeps its pasted text, so pressing Enter again sends the paste instead of the literal [Paste #N - M lines] placeholder
- The /plugin manager no longer shows a repository plugin that did not load as enabled, and plugin lists no longer say its directory was not found when its source points outside the marketplace
- `copilot help sandbox` now says that on macOS, sandbox host rules block direct TCP connections to local ports, such as a build client reaching its daemon; localhost stays reachable only through the local proxy, as HTTP or a CONNECT tunnel from a proxy-aware client
- `copilot workflow run --help` now lists a Microsoft 365 account among the sign-ins that can run workflows, alongside usage-based billing and a custom model provider (BYOK) while signed out of GitHub
- The /subagents model picker reopens for the same agent and accepts input after switching away from a session and back
- Keep on/off states and model picker arrows visible in /subagents settings in narrow terminals
- Opening a sub-agent's view no longer writes escape sequences or control characters from its task prompt to the terminal
- /copy keeps its formatting when pasted into Word, Outlook or Teams, and keeps each message of a multi-message response as its own paragraph, table, list or quote
- Model-switch prompts stay with the session that raised them and reappear when you return to that session
- /settings list items display every character when typing or viewing saved values on terminals 20 columns wide or narrower
- Permission prompts and other dialogs at the bottom of the screen no longer stay scrolled down after the terminal gets shorter and then taller again, so the extension environment-variable prompt shows the variable names it lists
- /feedback warns when the additional logs path contributes no files to the feedback bundle
- Emoji and other Unicode characters display correctly under the search cursor in the Issues and Pull requests tabs
- Keep paths and variable names containing emoji or CJK characters correctly truncated and aligned in /sandbox
- Links with balanced parentheses now open the full URL when clicked in your messages, shell commands, and shell output
- Session limit dialogs stay with their session, leaving other sessions free for typing when you switch.
- `copilot mcp get` correctly reports unconfigured server names such as `toString` as not found in text and JSON output
- Sessions sidebar actions no longer create or switch sessions while the CLI exits, keeping the exit summary's resume commands valid
- Text and number editors in /settings keep typed values visible inside the dialog on narrow terminals.
- Tool previews keep emoji intact, display SQL and agent messages as plain text, and keep memory vote previews on one line
- The @ file picker keeps emoji and accented characters intact and preserves the @ prefix when shortening paths in narrow terminals
- /lsp logs error summaries fit the available width without splitting emoji, and server messages display as plain text
- Arrow keys and Tab follow the highlighted action after using j/k or Ctrl+N/Ctrl+P in the /environments add-connection dialog
- Pasted text stays in the correct position when you press Esc or Ctrl+C immediately after pasting in Vim mode
- Keep the Sessions tab responsive when queued commands open dialogs such as /login
- Ctrl+C reliably cancels newly queued prompts without running them or showing a submission failure.
- Show the welcome header and Getting started box when cancelling the session picker at startup.
- Prepare organization-required plugins once at startup, avoiding duplicate installations and repeated success or failure notices
- Tool permission prompts keep their title and selected answer visible in short terminals, with PgUp/PgDn to scroll command or file details
- MCP system prompt reviews display plain text without allowing terminal controls to restyle, link, or hide content
- /plugin clears the marketplace update badge and count when a re-check confirms no update is available
- Untrusted-folder warnings in prompt mode now identify skipped workspace MCP configuration in parent directories and the folder to trust to load it
- `copilot help environment` documents `COPILOT_MCP_TOOL_CACHE` again, the variable that turns off the MCP tool snapshot cache for every server
- Agent, code search and IDE tool rows in the timeline show model- and IDE-written text as plain text instead of passing its escape sequences and control characters to the terminal
- /model plan now refuses extra arguments instead of saving or clearing the plan model without them, and reads PLAN and --plan plan as the plan keyword
- Question rows in the timeline show the question text while awaiting an answer, after you decline, and when Autopilot answers.
- Count previously used AI credits toward the session limit when resuming a session
- Respect .gitattributes binary settings for untracked files in /diff and exclude their contents from added-line counts
- Show only relevant options in argument error usage lines instead of listing every CLI option
- Pasting into @ or # mentions and immediately pressing Enter, Tab, or Ctrl+Y no longer selects a file or issue from the previous results
- Keep the highlighted agent visible in /agent when the list is taller than the terminal
- Show URL-like names containing Markdown characters in /env without stray backslashes
- Keep your instructions visible in chat and session history when /pr fix conflicts or /pr fix all opens the merge-strategy picker
- MCP inspection commands warn when workspace MCP configuration is skipped because the folder is not trusted and explain how to trust it
- Show your organization's support link in prompt-mode warnings when device policy disables --yolo or --allow-all flags
- The session picker explains when --connect cannot find a remote session or task, or when the lookup fails
- Install plugins from repository paths containing @, including scoped package directories
- Keep the /diff search cursor visible in narrow terminals and show the match count when space allows
- Keep the highlighted choice visible when navigating long lists in Copilot questions and MCP forms.
- Opening the Sessions tab or sidebar while the CLI exits keeps the screen visible instead of blanking it
- Keep the ellipsis visible on truncated session names in the Sessions tab, even in narrow terminals
- Keep footer paths, branch names, and status text properly fitted when folder or branch names contain wide characters such as Chinese, Japanese, or Korean.
- /tasks includes sub-agent follow-up run time after resuming a session
- Running /exit or /quit twice quickly with the Sessions sidebar open exits the CLI instead of leaving a blank, unresponsive terminal
- Keep goal panel todo counts accurate when returning from full-screen views such as /help or /environments
- Keep the /settings record editor and typed keys inside the dialog on narrow terminals
- Hide the unavailable Update action in /plugin for disabled local-marketplace plugins whose folders cannot be found
- Show MCP server saves queued during an active turn as status messages instead of errors
- Keep highlighted conversation text readable when its color matches the selection, search match, or hovered row background
- Long plugin folder paths containing emoji display correctly when shortened in Enable and Disable dialogs
- Markdown tables in replies fit narrow terminals without splitting borders and rows across lines
- /env no longer lists instruction files disabled in /instructions as loaded
- Keep Autopilot objectives and subagent descriptions readable when their text contains terminal escape sequences
- Changing editorMode with /settings takes effect immediately after toggling /vim
- Show complete filenames in collapsed Read, Create, and Edit rows when they wrap in narrow terminals
- Keep /search match counts readable beside long queries and in narrow terminals
- /help tables stay correctly aligned when resizing the terminal with the Sessions sidebar open
- Keep highlighted permission prompt answers and typed replies readable on narrow terminals
- Keep the /model picker's details and keyboard hints displayed correctly after rescanning providers with no search matches
- Keep retry notices above the reply or final error when switching back to a session that retried in the background
- Issues and pull requests picked with # include their details when you send or queue a prompt while the agent is working
- Keep Vim undo and repeat commands scoped to the current draft after sending or queuing a prompt from INSERT mode
- Keep the prompt responsive after widening a narrow terminal when Left was pressed twice to open the Sessions sidebar
- Show the full server list and keyboard hints in /mcp auth after loading
- Keep the command description and exit status visible in collapsed failed Shell rows with long single-line output
- The built-in GitHub MCP server is no longer available when your organization's policy disables MCP servers
- Subagents now respect the session-wide AI credit limit set with --max-ai-credits
- /env displays configured names literally instead of interpreting them as Markdown blocks or emoji shortcodes
- `copilot mcp remove` and `/mcp delete` now say that a server passed with `--additional-mcp-config` comes from that option and cannot be removed, instead of calling it not found or a built-in server.
- /subagents keeps the cursor on the subagent you just configured after you press Esc in its settings menu, so Space no longer turns off a different subagent
- Screen-reader mode names the current /config section correctly on narrow terminals
- Pasting into /plugin, /skills, and /mcp search preserves text after the cursor, even when the paste ends with an incomplete escape sequence
- Prompt text displays fully and handles line breaks correctly when pasted after slash commands, typed, edited with Ctrl+G, or recalled from history.
- The model picker no longer runs past the top or bottom of the screen when its key hints wrap onto more lines, on narrow terminals and beside the docked Sessions sidebar
- Keep each retry's reasoning with its own answer after an interrupted response
- The session limit prompt shown before the final model call no longer rounds the used AI credits up to the limit, so it no longer says "Session limit almost reached" beside "used 300 of 300 AI credits"; it shows the same figures as the session limits line in the timeline, such as 299.6 of 300
- Keyboard navigation and word deletion in the prompt keep image attachments and pasted-text labels intact
- Rewinding to a message sent while the agent was working now restores the files the agent changed in reply to it
- Typing /compact again while a compaction is running no longer hides the running compaction's indicator, and Ctrl+C and Esc Esc still stop it
- A plugin in a local directory marketplace whose catalog path points at a file instead of a folder no longer stops every MCP server from starting; that plugin is skipped with a warning naming it and the path
- Team plugins install from marketplaces on a specific branch or tag, or in a repository subfolder
- Improve best-effort startup on macOS Ventura 13.5 or later without expanding official OS support
- Use each model's recommended context window by default, while preserving explicit context choices
- /chronicle cost-tips now includes Copilot App sessions, recommends cheaper models and reasoning settings based on your usage, and reports sooner when local usage is available
